subject: SOC 2 re-attestation: retention window change + inference capacity uplift
messages:
From: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@lumenworks.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood-inference.com
Cc: legal_ops@lumenworks.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SOC 2 re-attestation — evidence retention window and throughput needs for renewal

Diego,

As we prepare to renew our contract (term ends Feb 28, 2027) LumenWorks needs to confirm two items for SOC 2 re-attestation: a longer audit-log retention window and increased inference throughput for a planned feature launch in Q2.

Summary of asks:
- Retention: we need an audit-log retention option of 90 days (current contract shows 30 days). SOC 2 coverage requires samples covering the last quarter for our compliance team.
- Evidence handoff: bulk export mechanism for logs (S3-compatible endpoint or secure transfer) and an evidence manifest that lists field names/timestamps.
- Capacity: temporary uplift of dedicated inference capacity from 10k to 18k tokens/sec for an anticipated two-month launch window beginning 2027-04-01; pricing and SLA implications needed.

I've attached a short request brief (LW-SOC2-request.pdf) with our compliance timeline. Can your team confirm feasibility, timing for evidence export, and an initial capacity pricing estimate?

Thanks,

Alicia Ramos
Head of Legal Ops, LumenWorks
alicia.ramos@lumenworks.com
+1 415-555-0192

Attachments: LW-SOC2-request.pdf

From: diego_fernandez@redwood-inference.com
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@lumenworks.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood-inference.com, marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com, jonas_weber@redwood-inference.com
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-attestation — evidence retention window and throughput needs for renewal

Alicia —

Thanks for the clear brief. We can support both requests but there are tradeoffs to scope and timing I want to surface. At a high level:

- Retention: we can extend the audit-log retention to 90 days as an addendum. This requires a small config change plus confirmation of export cadence; for large per-customer retention we do a short ticket to provision and ensure backup/archival cost is accounted for.
- Evidence export: we provide an S3 export workflow and a CSV/manifest schema. I'll attach a starting evidence plan and a proposed schedule for collection and validation.
- Capacity uplift: we can offer a temporary dedicated capacity bump with a guaranteed throughput SLA. I attached a capacity proposal with pricing tiers; network egress and reserved GPU hours will affect the final figure.

Next steps I propose:
1) Internal technical review (kimberly) to confirm retention/backend implications.
2) Draft contract amendment language (marissa) for the 90-day retention and a two-month capacity addendum.
3) Tentative dates: evidence handoff dry-run by 2026-12-15, capacity uplift effective 2027-04-01 — we'd need a signed amendment by 2027-03-01.

Attachments: RI-evidence-plan.xlsx, capacity-proposal.pdf

Can the LumenWorks compliance team confirm the dry-run window and which S3 region you'd prefer?

Best,

Diego Fernandez
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
diego_fernandez@redwood-inference.com

Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-attestation — retention window change + inference capacity uplift

Diego / Alicia —

Quick tech readout from infra/compliance side: we can support a 90-day retention for the audit log fields relevant to SOC 2 (auth events, config changes, API request/response metadata). Implementation notes:

- Storage: retention flagged as "audit-archive" will be moved to a cold S3 tier after 30 days unless requested otherwise. Cold-tier retrieval is within SLA but has a 2-hour prep window.
- Export: we will provide a signed pre-signed-preserved-bucket path with an index manifest (CSV) that includes: event_id, timestamp, user_id, request_id, model_id, token_count, response_hash. Example manifest row included in attachment.
- Redaction: We will not include PII fields in the exported manifest by default; if you need additional fields, we need a data processing addendum.
- Throughput uplift: we can carve additional reserved capacity. To hit sustained 18k tokens/sec for the two-month window we recommend a 2-node reserved pool + 30% burst headroom. Estimate and invoice details in capacity-proposal.pdf.

Proposed timeline:
- 2026-12-15: dry-run of evidence export (sample 7-day period)
- 2026-12-20: validation call with LumenWorks compliance (30m)
- 2027-03-01: sign amendment to enable 90-day retention and reserved capacity for the launch window

I'll attach a sample retention config (retention-config.yaml) and a manifest example. If LumenWorks accepts cold-tier retrieval windows and the manifest schema, we'll draft the amendment language.

Thanks,

Kimberly Park
Director, Infra Security | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: SOC 2 re-attestation — retention window change + inference capacity uplift

Kim / Diego —

Thanks for the quick follow-up and the artifacts. LumenWorks confirms: we accept the 90-day retention on the audit manifest fields (as described) and the cold-tier retrieval window. We also want the 2-node reserved pool + 30% burst headroom for the period 2027-04-01 to 2027-05-31.

Two items before sign-off:
1) Final pricing and the amendment language for our legal review. Can you send a DocuSign-ready amendment and the line-item invoice?
2) During the dry-run on 2026-12-15, we need the S3 region to be us-west-2. Please confirm pre-signed URL expiry (we prefer 7 days) and encryption-at-rest details.

If we get the amendment and invoice this week, our procurement can turn it around quickly; otherwise we risk missing the 2027-03-01 sign date.

Appreciate the coordination — we view this as a modest upsell and prefer to bundle with the renewal.

Regards,

Alicia Ramos
Head of Legal Ops, LumenWorks
